note: The milestone sequence scripts/test-native-xnu-entry.py already asserts in QEMU, written down as one list so a handset record can be judged against the same sequence. The transport that carries these markers on real hardware is not chosen yet: a GOP framebuffer console written after ExitBootServices, or a reserved RAM mailbox read back by a diagnostic EFI application. Until it exists, P1 cannot be judged, because a successful entry and a hang both look like a black screen.

checkpoints.proves: DarwinBoot transferred control to the kernel image at its entry point, with the ADT boot arguments it built.
The kernel reached arm_vm_init, so the pmap and the early memory map are usable rather than merely parsed.
arm_vm_init returned: the VM structures were built without a fault.
The source corecrypto provider was entered after VM setup.
The provider returned and its POST ran; the fixture also reads its status word.
PE_init_iokit was entered: the platform expert is bringing up the driver tree.
PE_init_iokit returned, which is the last checkpoint this port has a QEMU fixture for.
